claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nitazoxanide at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill most human cancer cell lines; its known activity is against anaerobic pathogens and viruses via host-regulated processes, with no described cytotoxic mechanism against cancer cells at this concentration.
